fields.title: OUN Developers Corporate Website
fields.project_scope: Designed and developed a high-end corporate website for an architecture and construction firm, focused on attracting premium clients and strategic partners. The solution emphasized clean visual hierarchy, fast performance, and clear service positioning to strengthen brand credibility, support business negotiations, and present the company as a reliable industry leader. The platform was optimized for responsiveness, search visibility, and professional storytelling to convert visitors into qualified leads.

fields.title: Kupon Oil & Gas Corporate Platform
fields.project_scope: Delivered an enterprise-grade corporate website tailored for the energy and oil services sector. The project focused on presenting Kupon Oil & Gas Limited’s capabilities, values, and operational strength with clarity and authority. Emphasis was placed on credibility, structured content, and executive-level presentation to support stakeholder confidence, partnerships, and contract negotiations within a highly regulated industry.

fields.title: GalaxyPL Business Website
fields.project_scope: Designed and deployed a responsive business website that enhances brand visibility, customer trust, and engagement. The solution focused on usability, performance optimization, and clear value communication—ensuring potential clients quickly understand services and benefits. The platform supports lead generation and positions the company as a dependable professional services provider.

fields.title: Pipeline Pigs and Accessories Limited
fields.project_scope:
Built an industrial-focused website designed to communicate complex pipeline and pigging solutions with clarity and precision. The project emphasized technical credibility, trust, and ease of understanding for decision-makers. Structured layouts and performance-optimized development were used to support lead generation, product visibility, and long-term brand authority within the industrial sector.

Tech stack: PHP · JavaScript · Bootstrap - product catalog, responsive UI & inquiry forms.

fields.title: Samben Security Corporate Website
fields.project_scope:
Developed a professional corporate website that reflects reliability, safety, and operational excellence. The solution focused on clear service presentation, confidence-driven messaging, and responsive design to build trust with prospective clients. The platform positions Samben Security as a dependable and professional security provider capable of handling critical safety requirements.

Tech stack: Django · PostgreSQL - corporate website with service showcase.

fields.title: Tareon Services Business Website
fields.project_scope: Delivered a modern, scalable business website designed to communicate expertise, innovation, and trust. The platform was structured to support business growth, client engagement, and professional credibility. Clean visuals, organized content, and performance-focused development ensure a strong digital presence aligned with enterprise expectations.

fields.title: B. G. Technical Limited Website
fields.project_scope:
A commanding corporate platform for B.G. Technical Limited - the ISO-certified oil & gas solutions provider founded in 1988, serving Shell since 1995, with 25+ years of excellence, 180+ successful projects and clients spanning NNPC, ExxonMobil, Chevron, TotalEnergies and Nigeria LNG. Presents eight service lines from pipeline & process services, pipeline construction, inline inspection and chemical & facility cleaning to pigs manufacture, production enhancement, wireline services and wellhead protection - alongside award & recognition galleries, client testimonials, case studies, careers and a quote-request engine engineered for conversion.

Tech stack: Django · PostgreSQL · Node.js - corporate platform with dynamic CMS.

fields.title: B.G. Technical Performance Dashboard
fields.project_scope: Developed a comprehensive performance intelligence dashboard designed to support executive decision-making and operational oversight. The solution consolidates profit, output, and departmental performance across markets and time periods, enabling leadership to monitor trends, identify growth opportunities, and assess operational efficiency. Structured dashboards and data models were implemented to transform raw operational data into actionable business insights that support strategic planning and performance optimization.

fields.title: BGT Management Travel Activity Tracker
fields.project_scope: Designed a structured travel activity tracking system to improve visibility, accountability, and planning of management movements throughout the year. The solution provides both monthly and daily-level insights, enabling leadership to analyze travel frequency, optimize scheduling, and support administrative reporting. This system enhances operational coordination while ensuring transparent documentation of management activities.

fields.title: Webstacka Financial Statistics Dashboard
fields.project_scope: Developed a multi-layered financial analytics solution designed to monitor income streams, operational performance, and project outcomes across regions and time periods. The solution includes interactive dashboards, pivot-based analysis, and geographical performance insights that enable leadership to assess revenue growth, track strategic initiatives, and evaluate project status. This system supports informed financial planning and performance evaluation.

fields.title: Royal Pride Tech Business Intelligence Repository
fields.project_scope: Built a centralized business intelligence repository delivering interactive dashboards and executive-ready visualizations to support data-driven decision-making. The solution transforms operational data into clear performance insights, highlighting trends, key performance indicators, and strategic opportunities. Power BI dashboards were complemented with presentation-ready summaries to support stakeholder communication, executive reviews, and strategic discussions.

fields.title: Budget Tracking & Variance Analysis Dashboard
fields.project_scope: Developed an integrated financial performance and variance analysis solution that compares planned budgets against actual results across departments and time periods. The system provides executive-level dashboards highlighting sales performance, year-over-year trends, and deviations from financial plans. By consolidating actuals, forecasts, and departmental inputs, the solution enables informed budgeting decisions, financial control, and proactive performance management.

fields.title: Employee Vacation Tracking System
fields.project_scope: Designed a centralized employee vacation tracking system to support workforce planning, transparency, and compliance. The solution provides daily visibility into leave schedules, ensuring adequate staffing levels while minimizing operational disruption. Structured data entry and reporting enable management to track utilization trends and improve human resource planning efficiency.

fields.title: Airbnb Market Performance & Revenue Analysis
fields.project_scope: Conducted an in-depth market and revenue analysis of Airbnb listings using interactive Tableau dashboards. The project provides insights into pricing patterns, revenue trends, geographic performance, and listing distribution across zip codes and property types. The analysis supports market evaluation, investment decision-making, and pricing strategy development within the short-term rental industry.

fields.title: House Price Prediction System
fields.project_scope: Designed and implemented a machine learning–driven predictive system to estimate residential property values using socio-economic and geographic indicators from the California Housing Dataset. The project involved comprehensive data preprocessing, correlation analysis, and feature evaluation to identify key price drivers, including median income, population density, and housing age. An advanced gradient-boosting regression model was trained and evaluated to deliver accurate price predictions, demonstrating strong generalization performance across unseen data sets. The solution highlights how predictive modelling can support real estate valuation, investment analysis, and strategic housing decisions.

fields.title: Fake News Detection & Classification System
fields.project_scope: Developed an end-to-end machine learning solution for detecting misinformation in digital news content using natural language processing techniques. The project involved large-scale text preprocessing, feature extraction through vectorization, and supervised classification to distinguish between legitimate and fake news articles. The system achieved high predictive accuracy by transforming unstructured textual data into meaningful numerical representations. This project demonstrates the application of AI to combat misinformation, enhance content credibility, and support responsible digital communication.

fields.title: Diabetes Risk Prediction Model
fields.project_scope: Built a predictive healthcare model to assess diabetes risk based on clinical and demographic indicators. The project focused on data standardization, supervised classification, and rigorous model evaluation to ensure reliable predictions. By leveraging machine learning classification techniques, the solution supports early risk identification and highlights how AI can assist preventive healthcare strategies. The project emphasizes interpretability, accuracy, and practical relevance in medical decision-support systems.

fields.title: Rock vs Mine Signal Classification System
fields.project_scope: Implemented a supervised learning classification system to distinguish between sonar signals reflected from rocks and mines. The project involved structured data analysis, model training, and performance evaluation within a cloud-based computational environment to ensure scalability and efficiency. This solution demonstrates the application of machine learning to pattern recognition problems, highlighting its relevance in defense analytics, signal intelligence, and real-time decision systems.

fields.title: Applied Random Forest Regression Analysis
fields.project_scope: Developed a regression-based machine learning model to predict task and completion durations using ensemble learning techniques. The project focused on understanding algorithmic behavior, feature importance, and performance evaluation through regression metrics. By applying Random Forest Regression, the solution captures non-linear relationships within the data and demonstrates how ensemble methods improve prediction accuracy and robustness across complex datasets.

fields.title: Grocery Sales Forecasting System
fields.project_scope: Designed a predictive analytics solution to forecast grocery sales and uncover demand trends within a retail environment. The project involved data cleaning, aggregation of transactional records, exploratory analysis, and time-based sales modeling. Predictive insights generated from the model support inventory planning, operational efficiency, and strategic retail decision-making. This project highlights the value of machine learning in optimizing sales performance and reducing uncertainty in competitive retail markets.

fields.title: Heart Disease Prediction & Classification Analysis
fields.project_scope: Developed a binary classification model to predict the presence of heart disease using structured clinical data. The project included exploratory analysis, class distribution assessment, supervised model training, and evaluation using accuracy and ROC–AUC metrics. Emphasis was placed on interpretability and diagnostic reliability, making the solution suitable as a baseline clinical decision-support model. The project demonstrates how machine learning can enhance early detection and healthcare analytics.

fields.title: Wine Quality Classification System
fields.project_scope: Implemented a multi-class classification model to predict wine quality scores based on physicochemical attributes. The project involved feature analysis, class distribution evaluation, and supervised learning to assess how chemical properties influence quality perception. The model provides interpretable insights into feature impact while highlighting challenges related to class imbalance. This project showcases the application of machine learning in quality control, product evaluation, and data-driven decision-making within the food and beverage industry.

fields.title: Housing Price Intelligence Using Decision Trees
fields.project_scope: A data-driven framework was designed to convert real estate datasets into reliable housing price insights using Decision Tree learning techniques. The implementation involved structuring multi-source data, identifying influential market variables, and training a transparent predictive model capable of explaining price behavior across different locations. By emphasizing interpretability and practical application, the solution equips decision-makers with clarity around value drivers, enabling smarter property evaluation, investment planning, and real estate market assessment.

fields.title: Savvy Chemicals Limited Corporate Website
fields.project_scope: Designed and developed a modern, responsive website for a leading industrial and specialty chemicals company. The platform showcases products, team, and services, emphasizing professionalism, credibility, and industrial partnerships. Features include interactive product listings, admin-managed dashboards, and contact systems to strengthen client engagement and industrial collaborations. Built with PHP, MySQL, JavaScript, jQuery, Bootstrap, and secure backend architecture.

fields.title: KGS Personal Portfolio Website
fields.project_scope: Developed a dynamic, SEO-optimized personal portfolio platform using Django, Bootstrap, and PostgreSQL. The site highlights projects, services, testimonials, and professional connections, with fully responsive design, admin-driven content management, and integrated social media links. Purpose-built to impress recruiters, convert clients, and showcase technical and design expertise, serving as a central hub for personal branding and professional growth.

fields.title: Three Heart Companionship Services Website
fields.project_scope:
A warm, heart-led corporate website for a UK companionship care provider supporting elderly individuals, adults living alone, and vulnerable people across London, Cambridgeshire, Essex, Hertfordshire, Northamptonshire and the West Midlands. Showcases six person-centred services - friendly companionship, shopping assistance, escort & social outings, errands & daily support, wellbeing visits and light domestic cleaning - with transparent from-25-pounds hourly pricing, DBS-checked carers, care stories blog, testimonials, FAQs and a free consultation booking journey designed to reassure families and restore confidence, dignity and independence.

Tech stack: Python · Django · PostgreSQL · JavaScript - full-stack CMS with service & pricing management.

fields.title: PLAN - Pipeline Professionals' Association of Nigeria Website
fields.project_scope:
A powerful membership and events platform for the Pipeline Professionals' Association of Nigeria - the nation's foremost network of pipeline engineers, regulators and energy experts with 500+ members, four regional chapters, 61 member companies and 64+ events. Features individual & corporate membership registration, the NIPITECS 2026 conference hub (10th edition), events calendar, industry insights blog, gallery, partner showcase and newsletter - crowned with a built-in 'PLAN Assistant' chatbot that answers membership and event questions instantly.

Tech stack: Laravel · MySQL · Bootstrap - 4-level RBAC, CMS, events, newsletter & chatbot.

fields.title: Dikaioo Engineering & Energy Corporate Website
fields.project_scope:
An authoritative corporate website for Dikaioo Engineering and Energy Ltd - a premier Nigerian EPC company delivering engineering, procurement, construction, installation, coating testing and quality assurance since 2000. Hero product: the Marine Thermo Simulator (ACCTU-001), a PLC-automated test rig that validates coating performance under four engineered stress conditions for FPSO, pipeline and offshore structures. Complete with mission & values storytelling, service showcases, team section and a smart enquiry form routing leads by service line.

Tech stack: JavaScript · Bootstrap - corporate website with SEO & lead generation.

fields.title: Sinacore Services Corporate Website
fields.project_scope: A polished corporate platform for Sinacore Services Limited - a multidisciplinary Lagos-based company powering oil & gas, construction and industrial clients with four integrated pillars: Technology & IT Services, Engineering & Industrial Support, Renewable Energy Systems Design, and Procurement & Supply Chain. Backed by world-class partners (Victron Energy, GoodWe, Growatt, Deye, Schneider Electric, Jinko Solar, Canadian Solar, LONGi), an IMS-certified policy, expert team profiles and sector-spanning client testimonials - all wrapped in a clean, enterprise-grade design.

fields.title: Zhehus Agric-Mechanics & Investments Website
fields.project_scope:
A bold multi-sector corporate website for ZHEHUS Agric-Mechanics & Investments Ltd - 'Building Today for a Better Tomorrow.' Showcases ten business lines: agriculture & agro-mechanization, petroleum & energy, electrical engineering, transport & logistics, general contracting, import & export, manufacturing, real estate, hospitality, and ICT & telecommunications. Includes service detail pages, industry sectors, team & partner showcases (Sobaz, Nugo, Zenith and Kupon Oil & Gas), client testimonials and a full admin panel for managing services, partners and content.

Tech stack: PHP · MySQL · Vanilla JS - responsive corporate website.
